verdict.rationale: Yubico exposes a scriptable CLI (ykman) and a YubiEnterprise fleet-management REST API that could be used to configure or manage many keys programmatically, hinting at bulk-capable automation, but no docs explicitly describe a bulk/batch operation (e.g., configuring N keys or revoking many credentials in one call). Missing for 10: explicit bulk-operation API/CLI documentation, batch examples, and independent confirmation that many items can be processed in one automated action.
